Third-party browser inference assets

This website runs all audio inference on the user's device. It does not use a
paid inference API. The following prebuilt resources are redistributed with
their applicable upstream licenses; the MIT license of this application does
not replace model or runtime licenses.

sherpa-onnx ASR runtime/API: v1.12.35, Apache-2.0
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
Official release bundle:
sherpa-onnx-wasm-simd-1.12.35-vad-asr-zh_en_ja_ko_cantonese-sense_voice_small.tar.bz2

sherpa-onnx speaker diarization runtime/API: v1.13.7, Apache-2.0
Official release bundle:
sherpa-onnx-wasm-simd-v1.13.7-speaker-diarization.tar.bz2

The JavaScript loaders and WebAssembly files are unmodified upstream release
files. The original .data preload packages are split into <50MiB static files;
models.json records exact sizes and SHA-256 checksums for reassembly.

SenseVoiceSmall model: FunAudioLLM / Tongyi Lab, original model and model card
https://github.com/FunAudioLLM/SenseVoice
https://huggingface.co/FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall
The weights use the FunASR Model Open Source License Agreement, not this app's
MIT license. See SenseVoice-MODEL-LICENSE.txt; source, author and model names
are retained here and in the website's model manifest.

Silero VAD model bundled in the upstream ASR package: MIT
https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad

pyannote segmentation 3.0 model: MIT (per upstream model card)
https://huggingface.co/pyannote/segmentation-3.0

Speaker embedding model from the official sherpa-onnx diarization bundle:
3dspeaker_speech_eres2net_base_sv_zh-cn_3dspeaker_16k.onnx
3D-Speaker, Alibaba Group / ModelScope (Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/modelscope/3D-Speaker
See 3D-Speaker-LICENSE.txt.

ONNX Runtime: Microsoft, MIT
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
See onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt.

OpenCC JS: v1.4.2, MIT AND Apache-2.0
https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js
https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC
See opencc-LICENSE.txt and sherpa-LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0 text).
